name: PlayerSprites
description: Replace your gamemodes with animated sprites!

ghost-trail-behavior.name: Ghost Trail Behavior
ghost-trail-behavior.description:
Defines how to handle GD's Ghost Trail when enabled, names are pretty self explanatory. 

- Untouched: Ghost Trail remains the same, will show the Vanilla GD icon sprites. 

- Replace: Will make the Ghost Trail show your currently active Sprite pack's sprite. 

- Disable: Disables Ghost Trail altogether.

export-folder.name: Export Folder
export-folder.description: Defines where exported sprite packs get saved as .zip files.
